name: Bouyoku no Fortissimo
original_name: 暴欲のフォルティシモ
source:
Tiger and Bunny receive a notice from their boss telling them to live together and intermingle more.
Will their pair be broken up if they fail?!
Cornered, Tiger decides to deepen his relations with Bunny.
Talk! Touch! Lovestruck?!
The two heroes' noisy daily lives!

[From Aarinfantasy Forums]
translation:
虎彻与巴纳比收到老板的通知，要他们住到一起，加深彼此的交流。
如果做不到，两人的搭档关系就会被拆散？！
被逼到走投无路的虎彻决定主动拉近与巴纳比的关系。
交谈！触摸！坠入爱河？！
两位英雄吵吵闹闹的日常生活就此展开！

[引自Aarinfantasy论坛]
